correctness.rationale: The occupancy identity χ_e=1−2x_e and χ_{e,f}=1−2x_e−2x_f+4x_ex_f proves restricted degree≤2 Walsh span equals columns x_ex_f of distinct-row/column pair incidences, since constants and coordinates sum from pair columns on a permutation. Independent deterministic recursion enumerated all nonattacking permutations n7..12 with counts 40,92,352,724,2680,14200 and constructed F2 bitset high-pivot elimination: full ranks n7..11; since integer minors nonzero modulo2 are nonzero over R, this establishes real tomography. Direct independent occurrence counts n11 yielded 5280 patterns with min frequency2, so no uniquely isolating pair. For n=12 at most C(12,2)*12*11=8712 columns, less than 14200 rows; nonzero signed left nullspace (whose sums vanish because constant in incidence span) gives distinct nearby probability laws. Degree1 upper dimension 1+(n−1)² < N for every n7..11. Every finite statement uses complete enumeration, not sample extrapolation. Source also contains replayable rank certificate and independent checker paths; our check did not treat their logs alone as proof.

final_claim: For ordinary labeled n×n nonattacking-queen solution supports, the degree≤2 Walsh restrictions span all solution functions for n=7..11 (rank 40,92,352,724,2680) and degree1 does not; for n=12 degree≤2 fails since 14200 solutions exceed at most 8712 pair-incidence columns. At n=11 every occurring two-queen pair admits at least two completions (5280 occurring patterns).
